thread:
nina: heads up 'Tracehooks migration' doc has a 404 link (/v1/traces/setup) and the python snippet still uses old Client(...) constructor. can someone patch quickly?

omar: thanks, i can open a tiny PR to swap the URL and update the snippet to the new class name.

tia: new sdk usage is `from redwood_sdk import Redwood` then `client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))`. i'll update and show env var example.

jack: please also add a single-line pointer to Console > Observability > Token cost breakdown — support keeps getting tickets after migrations. a permalink would help.

omar: use https://app.redwood.ai/console/observability/costs (redirects in prod).

tia: will add the pointer and a screenshot placeholder (with alt text). also noticed the example emits `service.version` which we no longer populate; i'll change to `span.set_attribute("deployment", "canary")` and add a small note about legacy attribute names.

jack: include a tiny legacy shim for older SDKs (4 lines) to reduce support noise.

omar: suggested shim snippet: `if not hasattr(client, "track_span"):
    def track_span(name, **attrs):
        return client.create_span(name, attributes=attrs)
    client.track_span = track_span`

nina: one more: remove the broken image link `https://storage.redwood.ai/missing/trace-costs.png` or replace it.

tia: replacing with new screenshot from design and adding alt text.

doc-bot: automated check: PR 1210 by tia includes link fix, sdk snippet update, shim, screenshot replacement. staging preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1210 — no broken links detected.

jack: quick review done. add a one-line changelog bullet under \"What changed\": \"SDK v2: client init and span attributes updated; see migration snippet.\" bump last-updated date.

tia: added changelog bullet and date, pushing commits.

omar: LGTM, tagging @docs-rollback for visibility.

nina: thanks all, will include in the next release notes. :thumbsup:

doc-bot: PR 1210 merged to main by tia at 1749999001, CI deploy succeeded.
